title: effort-indexed-budgeting-hc-tranches-and-rate-scan-jul2026
body:
Executive summary:
This is an experiment to couple an effort-indexed budgeting framework (EIB) with headcount tranching and per-route pricing sensitivity. Goal: produce a lightweight sheet that connects engineering effort (sprints/hours) and feature-weighted FTEs to incremental capacity cost and three pricing scenarios. Intended audience: finance, product leads (dedicated & hosted), and platform PMs.

Key definitions / assumptions:
- Effort-index (EI): normalized score (0.0-1.0) that maps a feature backlog slice to expected engineering & SRE effort for Q horizon. EI = (story points * complexity factor) / baseline-team-capacity.
- Tranche buckets: Core (A), Support (B), Experiment (C). Each tranche maps to a hiring/ramp profile and SLA expectations.
- Unit cost drivers: fully-burdened FTE (salary + benefits + bench) and marginal GPU-hour cost (cloud + ops).
- Pricing scenarios: Base (no change), Downside (-15% avg price), Upside (+10% price).
- Time horizon: 12 months from 2026-08 to 2027-07.

Sheet layout (rows as sections, columns as months / scenarios):
1) Effort forecasting (per feature group): EI per month, months of peak and baseline.
2) HC tranches: FTE count per tranche, ramp schedule (months to full productivity).
3) Fixed vs variable costs: office/infra (fixed), GPU-hours & burst (variable).
4) Pricing sensitivity: revenue impact by scenario and implied net margin.
5) Token/throughput breakpoints: tokens-per-second vs cost-per-token at different quantization profiles.
6) Decision triggers: when to hire, when to shift tranche, when to implement quantization or caching.

Sample (condensed table excerpt):
- Tranche Core (A): target 28 FTEs (eng + sres + infra-support). Ramp: +8 in M1, +8 in M3, +12 in M6. Full productivity assumed month 9.
  - Avg fully-burdened cost per FTE: $220k/year => monthly equivalent $18,333.
  - Ops GPU incremental per month at baseline: 1800 GPU-hours -> $85k/month.
- Tranche Support (B): target 12 FTEs. Ramp: +4 M1, +4 M4, +4 M7. Burdened FTE $150k/year. GPU incremental 400 GPU-hours -> $19k/month.
- Tranche Experiment (C): target 6 FTEs, flexible contractors. Mixed billing; assume blended $12k/month per head. GPU incremental variable for experiments: 150 GPU-hours -> $7k/month.

Effort-index mapping and incremental hires needed (illustrative):
- Baseline EI (0.45): maintains Core throughput; no hires outside planned ramp.
- EI spike (0.75) sustained 3 months: requires +6 temp SRE/infra hires (contractors) or shifting two Core hires earlier; increases GPU-hour usage by ~22%.

Pricing sensitivity model summary (12-month aggregation):
- Base price: Revenue $58.2M; Cost (ops + HC + infra) $26.7M; Gross margin 54.1%.
- Downside (-15% avg price): Revenue $49.5M; Cost same nominal -> Gross margin 46.1% (margin loss ~8ppts).
- Upside (+10% avg price): Revenue $64.0M; Gross margin 58.3% (improvement ~4.2ppts).

Break-even headcount levers (fast check):
- For every 5% permanent drop in average realized price, need to reduce effective FTE expense by ~12% or cut variable GPU-hours by ~18% to maintain target margin.
- Implementable levers mapped to teams: Serving-runtime (kernel / quant gains), Optimize (batching & cache), Product (per-route price increases), Sales (commitment pricing).

Scenario playbook (operational triggers):
- Early-warning indicators: rolling 6w avg of realized price < -5% vs plan OR GPU-hours growth > 14% QoQ -> convene Ops/Finance for 48h mitigate plan.
- Short-term response: delay tranche C hires, push quantization rollout to prioritized routes, reduce burst budget by 25%.
- Medium-term response: re-phased hires in tranche B, accelerate Dedicated SKUs pricing promotion, re-negotiate spot GPU commitments.

Open questions / next steps:
- Validate EI mapping with two feature teams (console rollouts + dedicated onboarding) by end of next sprint.
- Run a token-level micro-sim that ties model mix (open vs quantized variants) to GPU-hour deltas per route. (Owner: Oliver Chen)
- Build a dashboard widget in Console that surfaces realized avg price and GPU-hour delta (owner: Nina Alvarez, target M2).

Appendix (quick formulas):
- Monthly FTE cost = (burdened_annual / 12) * FTE_count * productivity_factor(month).
- GPU cost adj = baseline_GPU_hours * (1 + demand_delta) * avg_gpu_hour_price.
- Realized price = list_price * (1 - avg_discount) * mix_weighting(route).

Notes (tone & context):
This is intentionally compact and somewhat rough — meant to be a shared working sheet for finance & product to iterate scenario knobs. There are deliberate simplifications: we have not modeled sales commission timing, tax jurisdiction variances, or multi-region GPU pricing differentials (these are follow-on items if the EIB approach is accepted).

Decision requested:
- Approve running a 6-week validation with two product routes (Console and Dedicated onboarding) and commit finance analytics time (0.3 FTE) to build the micro-sim.
- If approved, tentative checkpoint 2026-09-02 for first consolidated run and a snapshot for exec review.

Owners & point people:
- Finance lead: Maya Singh (owner)
- Cost micro-sim: Oliver Chen (applied infra economics)
- Console metric hook: Nina Alvarez (product analytics)
- Serving runtime quant pipeline: Ethan Park (applied-ml/serving)

-- end of sheet excerpt --
